findings.text: extend_sample_current_response duplicates the column completion owned by nova/imas/diiid_current.py:203 and is invoked only from scripts/prototypes/diiid_finite_edge_booking/{measure,smoke,discriminate}.py, so every other consumer of build_profile followed by complete_profile_current_adapter - benchmarks/diiid_current_pinned_forward.py:345, benchmarks/diiid_residual_decomposition.py:152, benchmarks/diiid_diverted_root_full_currents.py:316, benchmarks/strict_exit_incidence.py:639, benchmarks/efit_forward_parity_slice.py:551 - now builds an operator whose sample.source_target keeps the 19 shipped columns while grid and wall are widened to 24 by the adapter (the seam guard at :1328 compares the sample target against source_to_grid, which is also 19 at that moment, so the mismatch passes), and the solve then contracts 19 against the 24-entry conductor vector: this is the same dot_general failure the worker recorded for job 1316894, relocated from the row driver to every benchmark that builds a DIII-D profile.

the helper _point restates the five-node 5/6 + 1/24 cell-average rule in the test file instead of driving the production point route at nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:3511, so the declared negative control proves that a copy of the stencil steps, not that the route the DIII-D builder would otherwise select steps, and a repair to the production point route would leave the control asserting a jump that no longer exists.

test_the_diiiid_builder_books_a_finite_edge asserts only that the module constant FINITE_EDGE_MOMENT_ROUTE equals "booked" and deletes its parametrised kind argument, so it would stay green if benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1294 stopped supplying the moment blocks or the sample target while the constant was unchanged; the route-selection clause of the done_when therefore rests on the uncommitted seam smoke rather than on this test.

FINITE_EDGE_MOMENT_ROUTE is a two-valued route switch on the DIII-D builder with a "point" branch at :1308 that sets every moment block to None, which is a new selection option on the builder contrary to the brief's "add no second integration path and no new public option"; the switch exists to drive the negative control and is otherwise dead in production.
